title: Holy Smokes There's Vampires In MallWorld? 🤯🧛
content: I was in a food court in MallWorld and noticed a small crowd of people in the center, there was some sort of disturbance, and suddenly one of the peoples was turning into a vampire. Chaos broke loose as everyone started to run. As I was running away it was impossible to find any doors to exit the mall, the outer walls were all windows, but no doors. Eventually I ran into a conference area that was hosting some sort of corporate event. And I was able to flee the vampire threat through the corporate crowd. I don't imagine things worked out well for some of them though...
